title: Live MuState Injection (Fork rho): the Lineage becomes the State
hypothesis: A phase change is injected into the RUNNING MuState: the melted claim replaces the pre-melt leaf in the active set, the engine re-seals, and H_t advances continuously (H_before -> H_after). This closes the EXP-516 audit-vs-live gap (Ghost #50): the provenance edge and the live world are the same chain. INTERFERENCE (solid-assumption intent applied to a now-fluid world) is resolved by OPTIMISTIC CONCURRENCY: actors stamp the H they read; injection is a compare-and-swap on H, and an intent whose basis_H != live H is rejected as stale -> the Agency must rebase. Engine FROZEN (core MuState/Claim/Provenance; no engine.* import).

mechanism.inject: new active = (active - {parent}) | {melted child}; re-seal -> H_t = HASH(Z+S+W+t); Z changes (new material stalk) so the chain advances. CAS: expected_H mismatch -> StaleStateError.
mechanism.interference: apply_intent(mu, intent): basis_H != mu.H -> rejected (stale_basis); rebase re-stamps against the live world; the Agency recomputes material-dependent fields before resubmitting.
mechanism.ghost_51: re-declaration changes Z; S accumulates the injection residual via the engine next_S().

invariance_note: the engine H_t hashes the raw Z (orientation-bearing) -> it is the continuous LIVE chain but NOT P_yz-invariant; the MATERIAL lineage witness (eigenvalue H_before/H_after, chi, child id with material-H payload) IS P_yz-invariant (Fork B).
engine_scope: NO engine edits. game/agency/injection.py uses core (MuState/Claim/Provenance/next_S/seal) + game.phase_change. state/operators/confluence/validity FROZEN.

[3] H_t continuity: record links before->after; child.provenance.parent_ids=(parent.id,), op=PhaseChange:minimal
[4] CAS guard: stale expected_H -> StaleStateError; correct expected_H -> success
[5] INTERFERENCE: solid intent (basis H_before) on fluid world (H_after) -> rejected stale_basis
[7] world is now fluid: injected active material chi == melted chi; Z changed (dZ>0)
[8] purity: input mu unchanged (still sealed, H==H_before; claims/active intact)
[9] stable/unsurvivable -> no injection (mu unchanged, child None)
assertions_fork_B: [1] P_yz: material_H_before & material_H_after invariant under Sector-D reflection
